palette.theme: muted ecological map; categorical landcover; ordered score light-to-dark teal
palette.note: All maps use one palette; absent/not-applicable kept distinct from numerical zero. Class colour is not quality rank.

notes: Use true linked scale bars and grid north with projection explained; no fake geographic grid.
No common ranking across habitat types; missing/excluded separate from low.
Panels use original scores/thresholds; do not fit new scientific classifications.
If map scores 0..1, continuous ramps allowed as visualization only; preserve approved discrete ER classes.
Every native QGIS project must open with relative paths and final default view.
